notes.title: Game-Changing Update is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

With summer upon us, things might seem to be moving at a slower pace, but behind the scenes, we’re hard at work on some exciting new updates for Tower! Simulator 3.

We're thrilled to announce that our next Places update is shaping up to be a major one. This update will bring you the third free airport and a significant visual overhaul. We’ve even shared some sneak peeks to give you a taste of what’s coming!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/5fdf327e730fcf4ee315a071aa92b8eb0d8d607e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/180d43e2e976163c5905065af3da2a4f04703c96.jpg

We’re also developing a new non-verbal interface, which we’ve teased with a few images. This upcoming update is set to be the largest we’ve released for Tower! Simulator 3. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/5a924e636a69c093a83c82f79a13c792628facfa.jpg

The changelog is evolving, and updates may come less frequently due to the size and complexity of each task. However, we’re making great progress and are excited to release this update soon. Afterward, we plan to accelerate the release of future updates and aim to bring you another free airport before the end of the year.

Attention, virtual air traffic controllers and simulation enthusiasts! Get ready to elevate your gaming experience with the latest and greatest update for Tower! Simulator 3—"Places 4." This isn’t just another routine update; it’s a major leap forward that redefines the very essence of ATC simulation. From stunning visual upgrades to enhanced gameplay mechanics, "Places 4" has it all.

Enhanced Control: New Mouse Commands and UI Features
Whether you prefer voice commands or not, Tower! Simulator 3 now offers a sophisticated non-verbal command system. With this update, every active aircraft will display a label with its callsign, allowing you to issue commands with just a click. The intuitive color-coded system will guide you through the urgency and importance of each command—so you can keep the traffic flowing smoothly with minimal stress.

Performance Boosts: Smooth Gameplay with FSR 3.0
Worried about performance? We’ve got you covered. The "Places 4" update includes ongoing optimizations to ensure your gameplay experience is as smooth as possible. With support for FSR 3.0 (FidelityFX Super Resolution), expect incredible frame rates and maximum visual fidelity without needing a top-of-the-line PC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/6a60396472e31245602425d433ed3e333021c487.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/850a47d9000149cbe3ca36acfd75f9023f754f90.png

For those eager about upcoming DLCs, we’re excited to confirm EHAM and VIDP. We’re also planning a summer release for an MSFS airport that has been highly requested for Tower! Simulator. This will launch for MSFS first, with the Tower! Simulator version following.

We hope you’re all enjoying your summer, and don’t forget to spend some time with Tower! Simulator 3. We believe this new update will reignite your enthusiasm for the sim and add even more enjoyment to your virtual flights.

Be safe, and best wishes to all of you!

The international airport, based in Kentucky and serving the Cincinnati region, throughout Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana and beyond.
The airport's code, CVG, is derived the words Cincinnati Vicinity and Greater. Serving commercial passengers since 1947 with more than an area of 7,700 acres (3,100 ha) and offers non-stop passenger service to over 50 destinations in North America and Europe, handling numerous domestic and international cargo flights every day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/6ed764008a9c81f8bf8f9e984cef86f9a0a19af7.png

The airport has one terminal and two concourses with a total of 51 gates. Both concourses are islands and are only accessible by an underground moving walkway and people mover. All international arrivals without pre-clearance are handled in Concourse B.

- Concourse A has 23 gates.
- Concourse B has 28 gates.

Terminals
This airport has two terminals: A and B. Terminal A is for national flights and Terminal B is for International flights. It also has an FBO terminal. It's airstrip is 10,170 ft-long by 147 meters-wide.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/6632517181c52dcbf609255640fd249e382b16cf.jpg

The airport has two levels. Ground (main) level's accessibility is directly from street; it has airline check-in counters (for both domestic and international) and the common airport services: restaurants, shops, post office, bank and currency exchange house.

Terminal A - Gates 1-5A for domestic flights
Terminal B - Gates 6-20B for all international flights

Runways
It presents a single runway, designated as 04/22, measuring 3,100 metres (10,200 ft) in length with an asphalt surface. The commercial aviation apron has 12 parking positions next to the terminal and eight remote positions. The general aviation apron provides stands for fixed-wing aircraft and heliports for private aviation.

notes.title: St. Louis Airport for Tower! Simulator 3
notes.content:
Find the Steam product page HERE

The airport provides nonstop service to airports throughout the United States, Canada, Europe and to sun destinations. In 2023 there were more than 270 daily departures to 80 nonstop domestic and international locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/7568edc78ea6b8e6173946351c669eb409440ec9.jpg

The airport has two terminals, five concourses, and 86 gates.

– Terminal 1 contains 36 gates across two concourses, lettered A and C. It also has an American Airlines Admirals Club and one of the nation’s largest USO facilities.
– Terminal 2 contains 18 gates across one concourse, lettered E. It also has a public lounge operated by Wingtips. All international flights without border preclearance are processed in Terminal 2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/21eca192ef6997997405d688a0a42ebb13078c06.jpg

Runways

The airport has four runways: three parallel and one crosswind. The crosswind runway, 6/24, is the shortest of the four at 7,607 feet (2,319 m). The newest runway is 11/29, completed in 2006 as part of a large expansion program.

notes.title: It is coming.... SOON!
notes.content:
This is not just an update or fix. This new version will leave you shocked! Designed to allow aviation fans, enthusiasts, ATC students and anyone interested in air traffic control to play and practice controlling from their living room.

This new version could showcase some of the cutting-edge technology we’ve been working on, including ultra high-res imagery, completely rewritten weather system. We’ll be offering this version as a training tool for Universities, students and air traffic control centers. By continuously receiving feedback from professionals, such as our partner the Department of Aviation of Hampton University, will ensure a very high level of simulation.

[previewyoutube=so4kQ4rnzkM;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be sharing with you some behind the scenes info on graphics and design. Showing you how we work on the terrain to make everything look even more realistic.

Tower! Simulator 3 is using OSM (Open street map) data to place houses, roads and even trees where they are in the real life. This gives the simulator a very realistic look, and the controller such an experience, like you’re right there.

Houses are replaced by typical buildings particular to that area, around the airport. This allows us to provide a great detail in design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/a8b41bd8f2bf694ef9858705f3d8301201d76758.png

The terrain inside the simulation doesn’t use satellite images anymore. This means basically any airport in the world can be built and implemented in the base simulator. The ground and the terrain use 16x more details than before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/2687ac863c8e1fb9bc3aa1a80867aa8a2cfdf392.png

This helps to keep every detail sharp and enjoyable even at a close range. So content creators and streamers, make sure to have your streams ready to show off!

We will regularly post updates during the development and beta, showcasing new images and features, so keep checking back here, or sign up to FeelThere’s newsletter / wishlist.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186447/44cb2b8d56efa241e15e54e26a0be4862946dec4.png
